messages.subject: Postdoc opportunity
parts:
Hello all,
This group has been a gold mine of very qualified and fantastic people to work with in the past, so please allow me to circulate this post-doc opportunity in my research group, on a number of projects ranging from invasive wild pig monitoring, disease-structure rodent community ecology, host-parasite distribution and dynamics, and more.
Looking for a highly qualified candidate with strong quantitative skills and adaptable to multiple systems.
Instruction to apply in the attachment.
Thanks
Mathieu Pruvot
